notes.title: Full Release !!! 19/05/2017
notes.content:
[h1]|Full Release !!!  19/05/2017|[/h1] 

Hi everyone,

The time has finally come where I can say Three Days is finished or to a point so close that only small fixes will rarely be needed. My plan is to continue updating all the small things people find but this is the full release.

Here is the Full release fix list:

[list]
     [*]Fixed achievements steam API now constant
     [*]Got a valid wiki setup ready for editing
     [*]Fixed difficulty listings switching from Boolean eg. Godmode = False,No
     [*]Finish gorepixelgames site ready for full release.
     [*]Fixed change log issues
     [*]Added twitter icon on start screen
     [*]Balanced level up system a bit. reduced rock values to 70XP
     [*]Scaling issues fixed
     [*]Fixed text on difficulty centring to side of box.
     [*]Added version number to start screen
     [*]Fixed god mode difficulty reading easy on difficulty screen
     [*]Fixed death animation being to small for water death
     [*]Fixed options menu to be more neat. GUI + organisation
     [*]Centred pause menu
     [*]Fixed clouds /birds overlaying on options menus
     [*]Fixed Start screen guy overlaying
     [*]Fixed easy mode health going above 120
     [*]Various misc Fixes
[/list] 

Note: There may be one patch in the next 24 hours as I cant fully test achievements until it is uploaded.


And we are done!

Thankyou very much everyone for your continued support up to this point its been just over a year since Three Days was released into early access, I hope you all stick around for future games.

,Lueshie (GorePixelGames).

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24315838/b6d9ca9797be7ad4acca4dd9d9d9e527e6d5070c.png[/img]

notes.title: Update B32 !!!
notes.content:
Hey all, 

Its that time again! , It's update day!

So what's been added this time? : 
 [*]Added flames and ash to the game
 [*]Trees + bushes can now be set alight by fires and spread to others.
 [*]Trees & bushes create new Wood Ash item
 [*]Player will heat up from flames
 [*]You can destroy objects using the delete key when mouse is over them
 [*]Fixed the music on the cutscenes and  credits
 [*]Surfaces can now be disabled on lower end pc's
 [*]Fixed /messed with code for scps to run away from fire/players
 [*]Fixed sharks from being able to spawn in land
 [*]Fixed fish from being able to spawn in land
 [*]Reinstated options menu for surface option
 [*]Walls/spike walls can now be uncrafted
 [*]Walls now mesh together


Any ideas and suggestions dont forget to post below , i will always listen and take notes on every comment and decide what is best to add into the game. 

Thanks for reading, 

Lewis Bergin.

notes.title: Update B31 !!!
notes.content:
Hey all, 

Its that time again where i let you know we have an update out!

So what's been added? :

    [*]Fixed Text over difficulty on difficulty screen
    [*]Fixed player name not displaying on one of the cutscene text's.
    [*]On the island the game pauses on the start text , (time pauses)
    [*]Shortened start tutorial from 12 slides to 8
    [*]Fixed Spiked wall bug crashing the game
    [*]Fixed crafting page and normal page having the same writing
    [*]1/7 chance of getting a redacted page
    [*]Added mute/sound button ingame
    [*]Fixed audio glitch in game over screen and added a death sound    effect.
    [*]Added Game Over text ,9 different texts will display at random
    [*]Added and implemented godmode
    [*]Fixed time of day to say time under it and not remain
    [*]Player UI removed from map
    [*]Added new map icon
    [*]Player displayed as you are here on map
    [*]Added map background 1536 x1152 and reduced zoom of map
    [*]Fixed crafting chart zoom and movement , a lot easier to navigate                        now!
    [*]Minor tweaks with some features, better performance
    [*]Fixed 1st story note so it displays the story note 1
    [*]Changed air temp to 75% and with |A| as temp symbol
    [*]Added 3 new death animations on gameover screen


So this is quite a big update and has been long awaited , i've tried to get as much as possible done after my holiday and hopefully this suffices your hunger for Three Days once more.


Any ideas and suggestions dont forget to post below , i will always listen and take notes on every comment and decide what is best to add into the game.

Thanks for reading,

Lewis Bergin.

notes.title: Update B30 !!!
notes.content:
Im excited to say our second update B30 has arrived with various new additions balances and fixes, it would be great to hear everyones feedback on the new additions again. you can take a look at whats been added below: 

||Update B30||EA Update_2||#
 [*]Added speech text for easy mode , they are extra hints
 [*]Backwards crafting added middle mouse button to uncraft
 [*]Added difficulty differences + gui to show what differences are in each mode
 [*]Fixed crafting chart buttons for ar_you_sure_room
 [*]Fixed some audio issues
 [*]Added difficulty stats for specific difficulties
 [*]Added animation to loading screen
 [*]Hardmode starts with fireplace
 [*]Added godmode and enabled it (Needs fixes)
 [*]Place items in godmode = X
 [*]Hidden godmode for next update
 [*]Started working and finishing UberHard + godmode

Many Thanks,

Lewis Bergin.

notes.title: Our first Update! B29
notes.content:
Im excited to say our first update B29 has arrived with various new additions balances and fixes, it would be great to hear everyones feedback on the new additions. Take a look at whats been added below:

||Update B29||EA Update_1||
Started on some new player speech help
Fixed player speech saying wrong dialogue
Added names to the characters in the startscreen.
Fatal error fixed for sidewalls
Fires can now be restocked anytime
If fire is lit it can restock with leafs
Slowed down button Text effects
Added cloud borders to map
Implemented easy/normal/hard mode
Implemented day/night mode
Added retry button to game over screen
Upgrade menu now toggles
SCP2432 cant attack when on upgrade menu
Creature's are invisible on map now
Temperature system is now more balanced
Added difficulty under stats
Added sound mute to startscreen(Will be added ingame)

Many thanks to everyone for the amazing support! , i hope you all enjoy!


,Lewis Bergin.
